question: How does threefold impurity bind?
premises: All impurities are limited distinct knowledge.
Threefold impurity has ignorance-nature knowledge form.
inference: The verse asks how threefold impurity binds.
plain_english: Thus in Pratyabhijna, anava-mala-based limited distinct knowledge is said; all impurities are only limited distinct knowledge. Now how does threefold impurity, of ignorance-nature knowledge-yoni-group-kala-body form, bind? Thus says.
